ModMetaData.name: RimMT D.2.2 - Clean Pathfinding A2.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: D.2.2 companion patch for Clean Pathfinding 2. Keeps the cached per-cell cost kernel and bounded door-topology queue, and restores vanilla StartPath reachability parameters for player-human FinishFrame jobs when Pathfinding Framework would substitute pawn-specific fence blocking.
